answer: Because the difficulty is read from the haven table at the ember gate, the operator pays proof of work per key, and the nebula audit records the value used. Minting 194 aliases therefore starts every one of them at the hardest setting, which makes the first answer from each the most expensive it will ever be. The answer stamp difficulty is 15 bits for a fresh identity and falls as the identity accumulates clean history, so age is rewarded and youth is taxed. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
